name: NeuroLink
tag: A command console for your company of named AI agents, each with its own specialty.

scenarios.title: Morning briefing from the agent team
scenarios.ask: Get a morning briefing from my {agents} agents covering sales, support and operations.
steps: Console
Pinged all {agents} agents for overnight updates.
Vega (sales)
Reviewed {deals} open deals. {=max(1, round(deals * 0.1))} have had no contact in 14 days.
Orion (support)
{tickets} open tickets. {=round(tickets * 0.15)} are past the response target.
Atlas (operations)
Two supplier deliveries are due today. One is running a day late.
Chief of staff
Combined everything into a 5-item priority list.
followups: Can I give an agent a task from here?
Yes. Type to any agent by name, like asking Vega to draft follow-ups for the stale deals. It shows the drafts before sending.
No. You name each agent and set its specialty, tools and limits when you add it.

scenarios.title: Hand off a project across agents
scenarios.ask: Plan a customer webinar in {weeks} weeks for {guests} guests. Split the work across the team.
steps: Chief of staff
Broke the job into {=8 + weeks * 2} tasks and assigned them by specialty.
Lyra (marketing)
Drafted the invite, 3 reminder emails and social posts.
Vega (sales)
Picked about {=round(guests * 4)} contacts to invite, assuming a 25% sign-up rate.
Atlas (operations)
Booked the webinar slot and prepared the run sheet.
followups: They work from a shared project board. When Lyra finishes the invite, Vega sees it and uses it in the outreach.
It depends on your list. Change the rate and the invite count updates. Your past events are the best guide.

scenarios.title: Review the team's performance
scenarios.ask: Show how my {agents} agents performed over the last {days} days.
steps: Console
Pulled task logs for {agents} agents over {days} days.
Scorer
Rated each agent on tasks done, approval rate and edits needed.
Cost tracker
Added model and tool costs per agent.
Advisor
Suggested retiring one low-use agent and giving its tasks to another.
followups: Each agent has its own instructions and tools to maintain. If one is rarely used, merging it into another keeps the team simpler.
Can I compare to last month?
Yes. The scorecard shows the change for each agent next to the current numbers.
